title: Owner interview answers (S3 output, context.yaml)
description: Per architecture.md S3: workflow criticality, PII presence, data-egress constraints, review workflows, data & governance map, source inventory, trust boundaries, declared tool/action boundary. Weights gap_model.json's prioritization once populated.

data_egress_constraints.description: e.g. region lock, no third-party LLM, contractual data residency

review_workflow.description: How releases/changes to this workflow get reviewed, if at all

data_governance_map.description: 'internal-only' is not 'low-risk by default' — describe what actually happens to data in this workflow

approved_handling_path.description: Required detail when approval_status is restricted

tool_action_boundary.description: The declared tool/action boundary for the current release — what the product is allowed to do autonomously right now
